description_en: Configures blocked regions for website domain name blacklists
description_zh: 设置网站业务区域封禁（针对域名）的封禁地区
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo modify-web-area-block --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --domain www.aliyun.com --regions CN-310000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyWebAreaBlock

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance in the Resource Management service. The default value is empty, which means the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name to operate on.

> The domain name must have website business forwarding rules configured. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
要操作的域名。

> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The list of regions to block.

> Not setting this parameter indicates turning off the location blacklist (for domain names) feature
parameters.help_zh:
要封禁的地域列表。

> 不设置该参数表示关闭区域封禁（针对域名）功能
parameters.name: regions
